subject: duck
name: 小鸭子
label: 漂浮的小鸭
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One duckling floating in side view with round head, broad bill, plump body and one wing arc.
Pure black contour illustration, smooth empty interiors. Exactly the listed distinguishing details, no extra small decorations, dense texture, hair strokes, hatching, shading or gray fills. Complete connected anatomy and clear all-around margins.
